immutable_protocol.creation: Both artifacts are written exactly once with exclusive binary create (Node fs.open flag wx); existing targets cause a stop. Each file handle is synced before closing.
immutable_protocol.byte_binding: SHA-256 is calculated over the exact UTF-8 fixture bytes, including the final newline, before exclusive creation. The created fixture bytes are reread solely to confirm their SHA-256.
immutable_protocol.protection: After creation, the fixture and seal are set read-only with fs.chmod(0o444), which applies the Windows read-only file attribute. The seal is not rewritten after sealing.
immutable_protocol.change_policy: Corrections require a newly versioned fixture and newly exclusive-created seal; do not unseal, overwrite, or amend either artifact.
immutable_protocol.limits: Read-only is a filesystem write guard, not cryptographic or administrator-proof immutability. The exact-byte fixture hash makes changes detectable; no seal self-hash is embedded.
